protocols.title: Winter High-Density Series 01
protocols.spec_notes: Recorded in acoustic chamber 3. Residual room tone at -62dB. Governed density structure: 90s entry, 900s hold, 120s close. Reference tone calibrated at 432Hz.

protocols.title: Winter High-Density Series 02
protocols.spec_notes: Extended hold protocol. Entry 120s, hold 1440s, close 240s. Maximum governed density. Recommended after three sessions at 0.88 density class.

protocols.title: Winter High-Density Series 03
protocols.spec_notes: Short-form high-density protocol. Suitable between work blocks. Entry 60s, hold 480s, close 60s. Same chamber as Series 01.

protocols.title: Low-Density Morning Protocol 01
protocols.spec_notes: Entry protocol for new practitioners. Minimal acoustic structure. Open room tone at -58dB. Entry 60s, hold 780s, close 60s. Suitable as first session.

protocols.title: Low-Density Morning Protocol 02
protocols.spec_notes: Extended low-density protocol. Same open room source as 01 with extended hold. Reference tone introduced at 8-minute mark.

protocols.title: Autumn Transitional Series 01
protocols.spec_notes: Mid-density transitional structure. Density moves from 0.30 to 0.72 over hold period using linear interpolation. Designed for density ramp practice.

protocols.title: Autumn Transitional Series 02
protocols.spec_notes: Reverse transitional: density begins at 0.75, descends to 0.28 over hold. Useful following high-density work blocks.

protocols.title: Winter Field Recording — Boreal 01
protocols.spec_notes: Recorded at 64.3°N, 26.8°E. Ground frost. Wind speed 2km/h. Ambient air temperature -11°C. Binaural capture. No post-processing applied beyond level normalisation.

protocols.title: Winter Field Recording — Boreal 02
protocols.spec_notes: Extended field recording. Same location as Boreal 01, recorded 72 hours later. Ice formation on recording surface introduced sub-20Hz resonance captured in full.

protocols.title: Spring Field Recording — Coastal 01
protocols.spec_notes: Recorded at 55.9°N, 4.5°W. Tidal state: 2h post high. Wind from NNW at 8km/h. Binaural. One vessel passing at 22 minutes — documented, not removed.

protocols.title: High-Density Protocol — 30min
protocols.spec_notes: Standard 30-minute high-density session. Protocol structure: entry 120s, hold 1500s, close 180s. Anechoic chamber. -72dB noise floor.

protocols.title: High-Density Protocol — 45min
protocols.spec_notes: Extended high-density. Recommended after minimum three 30-minute sessions at 0.80 density class. Same anechoic source. Density peaks at 0.87 at 22-minute mark.

protocols.title: Low-Density Open Protocol
protocols.spec_notes: Introductory protocol available to all access tiers. Minimal governed structure. Suitable as a first entry to MA-ZEN discipline.

protocols.title: Summer Field Recording — Highland 01
protocols.spec_notes: Recorded 57.1°N, 3.8°W. Altitude 840m. No wind. Temperature 14°C. Capture device: Sennheiser MKH 8040 stereo. Single sheep at 11 minutes — unedited.

protocols.title: Archival Session — Chamber A, 1994
protocols.spec_notes: Restored from analogue tape. Original recording: acoustic chamber A, date unknown, estimated 1994. Tape hiss preserved. Density structure consistent with pre-digital MA-ZEN protocols.

protocols.title: Archival Session — Field, Northern Province 1999
protocols.spec_notes: Restored from DAT. Estimated northern latitude. Recording circumstances undocumented. Significant sub-20Hz content throughout.

protocols.title: Winter Transitional — Entry Series 01
protocols.spec_notes: Transitional entry protocol for winter series. Bridges low-density practice to high-density sessions. Density arc: 0.18 → 0.65 over 780 seconds.

protocols.title: Spring Low-Density Series 01
protocols.spec_notes: Spring low-density protocol. Open room. Natural resonance from concrete structure at 94Hz. Entry 90s, hold 990s, close 120s.

protocols.title: Spring Low-Density Series 02
protocols.spec_notes: Extended spring low-density. Same source room as 01. Secondary reference tone introduced at 528Hz for 240s from 8-minute mark.

protocols.title: High-Density Protocol — 15min
protocols.spec_notes: Short high-density protocol. Entry 60s, hold 780s, close 60s. Suitable between deep work blocks where 30-minute session is not viable. Same anechoic source.

protocols.title: Autumn Field Recording — Forest Floor 01
protocols.spec_notes: Recorded 47.8°N, 13.2°E. Beech forest. Post-rainfall. Humidity 94%. Leaf decay sub-frequency at 18-24Hz throughout. No wind movement during recording.

protocols.title: Autumn Field Recording — Forest Floor 02
protocols.spec_notes: Same forest, recorded 6 days later. Dry conditions. Density class increases by 0.02 due to reduced atmospheric moisture. Direct A/B with 01 is a practitioner reference exercise.

protocols.title: Observer Protocol — Open Entry
protocols.spec_notes: 5-minute introductory protocol. Ungated for observer tier. Minimal governed structure. This is the entry point to MA-ZEN protocol discipline.

protocols.title: Summer Seasonal Series 01
protocols.spec_notes: Mid-density seasonal protocol for summer cycle. Designed as counterpoint to winter high-density work. Structure held constant across 2025 summer series.

protocols.title: Summer Seasonal Series 02
protocols.spec_notes: Extended summer seasonal. Density held at 0.51 ± 0.02 throughout. No transitional arc. Stable governed structure for extended practitioner sessions.
